text:
sara: Ran a KV eviction sensitivity sweep — FP8-KV vs INT8-KV on llama-2-13B-kv (serving runtime v2.4.1). Posting quick summary and raw numbers.

kevin: Nice. What's the workload shape? long chats or lots of short turns?

sara: Synthetic mix: 60% short (<=64 tokens), 30% mid (64-512), 10% long (>512). Prefix cache enabled. Eviction threshold varied 1..8 entries per shard, churn simulated with background traffic.

benchbot: Results paste (aggregates across 10 runs each):
```
Config                | Mem(inst) GB | P50(ms) | P95(ms) | KV-hit% | PPL delta
FP8-KV ev=1          | 6.1          | 45      | 210     | 78%     | +0.6%
FP8-KV ev=4          | 5.5          | 46      | 230     | 70%     | +0.9%
FP8-KV ev=8          | 5.0          | 47      | 305     | 58%     | +1.7%
INT8-KV ev=1         | 6.9          | 48      | 220     | 80%     | +0.4%
INT8-KV ev=4         | 6.3          | 49      | 245     | 68%     | +1.6%
INT8-KV ev=8         | 5.7          | 51      | 330     | 55%     | +2.8%
```

sara: Notes: FP8-KV gives ~10-15% memory reduction vs INT8-KV in these runs (because of packing/align). Tail latency (P95) degrades notably when eviction churn reduces KV-hit below ~65%.

nora: Clarify: quantization applied only to KV cache tensors, right? We didn't touch model weights?

sara: Correct — only KV cache tensors quantized (FP8/INT8). Base weights pinned at fp16 for the tests.

jaime: Any sign of increased token error / hallucination from quantized KV? PPL delta looks small but curious about hard QA examples.

sara: Quick manual QA on a 200-sample question set: FP8-KV ev=4 had 2/200 semantic regressions (paraphrase mismatch), INT8-KV ev=4 had 6/200. Not exhaustive, but consistent with PPL trends.

river: What's the mechanism for the big P95 spikes at higher ev thresholds?

sara: Observed eviction storms: when many shards evict concurrently we see repeated re-computation of attention KV materialization -> bursts of GPU work + PCIe copies. Essentially GC-like thrashing. We correlated P95 spikes with KV repop bursts in the traces.

kevin: Production recommendation?

sara: :memo: Recommendation: default to FP8-KV with eviction=2 (balanced: ~8-10% mem saved, PPL <1% delta, P95 within SLO). Use INT8-KV only for capacity-constrained Dedicated pools but increase instance count or bump concurrency limits to absorb tail (or use eviction=1). Also add an automatic fallback: if KV-hit% drops below 60% for >30s, route requests to fp16-kv variant (no quantization) until steady state.

kevin: :thumbsup: Can you add these configs to the model profile and tag a canary rollout? I can manage canary traffic.

sara: Will push model profile change + perf traces to the model repo. Logs and flamegraphs uploaded: https://bench.internal/1834679012/trace (internal).

benchbot: Recorded run id=1834679000 in benchdb, tags=[fp8-kv,eviction-sweep,v2.4.1].

nora: Thanks — I'll draft a short runbook summarizing eviction thresholds, how to interpret KV-hit%, and tracer checks. We should also add an alert for repeated eviction storms.

river: Great work, useful data. Let's schedule a 15m sync if kevin wants to roll canary this week.

sara: OK, will follow up with a PR for the model profile tonight.
